notReleased.Cargo.toml: the root of the Cargo workspace of the core and the binding crates; it carries no version
notReleased.package.json: the private development root: the TypeScript compiler, @polyspec/kit, @polyspec/binding and the napi CLI of the checkout
notReleased.composer.json: the private development root: PHPUnit, which runs the tests of the PHP extension
notReleased.packages/go/go.mod: the Go module of the binding: make release-go-module carries it in a commit with the generated files and the static library of each platform and creates the tag packages/go/vX.Y.Z of that commit (binding GN-19f), which kit does not make, so goModules names no module and no tag of kit releases it
